bio: A dining experience at Bouwkunde is one to be savoured. After being welcomed by the cordial hostess, you can soak up the warm atmosphere of this charming restaurant. Diners will see that wine plays an important role here. The ostensibly classic and simple cuisine proves to be full of surprises and bold flavours. For example, a beurre blanc with a judicious squeeze of lemon enhances a beautifully translucent fillet of skrei. And all at great value for money!...
